note: 人工精译参考（用于对比机翻质量）

sentences.en: Welcome back to the workshop, where we turn raw footage into finished films.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到工作坊，我们在这里把原始素材变成成片。

sentences.en: Today I will show you three simple tricks that save about two hours of editing time.
sentences.zh: 今天我会演示三个简单的小技巧，能省下大约两个小时的剪辑时间。

sentences.en: First, always cut on the beat, because rhythm is what keeps the audience awake.
sentences.zh: 第一，永远在节拍上剪，因为节奏才能让观众保持清醒。

sentences.en: Second, remove the silent gaps longer than half a second before you touch the colors.
sentences.zh: 第二，在碰调色之前，先把长度超过半秒的静音空隙去掉。

sentences.en: Third, normalize the audio to minus sixteen LUFS, which is the standard for online video platforms.
sentences.zh: 第三，把音频响度归一到负十六 LUFS，这是在线视频平台的标准。

sentences.en: Finally, export at fifteen megabits per second, and never trust the first render.
sentences.zh: 最后，以每秒十五兆的码率导出，而且永远不要相信第一次渲染。

sentences.en: That is it for this episode, see you in the next one.
sentences.zh: 本期就到这里，我们下期见。
